headline: LAA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.06 at CLE 4.64, with a projected total of 7.70. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: LAA moved -0.80 runs while CLE moved -0.08, changing the projected margin by -0.72 runs. The projected total fell -0.88, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Parker Messick has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Nolan Schanuel, Chase DeLauter, Mike Trout, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rhys Hoskins, Sebastián Rivero because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
